#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>

int choose_two(int n) {
    if (n < 2) return 0;
    return n * (n - 1) / 2;
}

int choose_three(int n) {
    if (n < 3) return 0;
    return n * (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 6;
}

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::stringstream ss(line);
    
    int n;
    double p;
    ss >> n >> p;
    
    int total = choose_three(n);
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        double prob = 0.0;
        double p1 = (double)i * choose_two(n - i) / total;
        double p2 = (double)choose_two(i) * (n - i) / total;
        double p3 = (double)choose_three(i) / total;
        prob = p1 / 2.0 + p2 + p3;
        if (prob >= p) {
            std::cout << i << std::endl;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}
